description: Defines the StreamingSession class which manages streaming session information, including namespaces, filtering criteria, and extra fields, as well as methods for merging thing data and filtering.

classes.name: StreamingSession
classes.description: Stores information about a streaming session, including namespaces, filtering criteria, extra fields, and methods for merging and filtering things.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new StreamingSession instance with specified namespaces, filter criteria, and extra fields.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces associated with the session.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra fields if any are set.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtra
methods.description: Merges thing information from a signal with extra fields, returning a Thing object.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if a given Thing matches the session's filter criteria.
